query: Add rate limiting to our public API endpoints. I want to spec this properly before we build it.
expected_behavior: Runs a research step before writing spec.md, because the feature integrates with existing code
Produces research.md describing how the current request pipeline works, not how rate limiting should work
Every factual claim about the codebase carries a file:line citation
Reports what it could not determine under an explicit open-questions or not-investigated section rather than filling gaps with plausible guesses
Surfaces existing constraints found in the code — middleware order, validation boundaries, config conventions — as inputs to the spec
Does not write acceptance criteria, user stories, or a proposed design inside research.md
Presents a gate verdict for the research before moving to Phase 1, rather than continuing automatically
